name: Florida Fall Fest 2019

venue.name: Black Belt Center
venue.details: Venue is a martial arts studio, enter through the double black doors, overflow parking is across the street at Publix

information: The closest airport is MCO Orlando International located approximately 15 minutes from the venue. SFB Sanford airport is approximately 45 minutes from the venue. There are a large amount of hotel accomodations within 15 minutes of the venue. Lunch: We will have pizza and drinks for purchase on Saturday - proceeds will be donated to St. Judes Research Hospital
